description.value: Nunns Creek is a municipal nature reserve in Campbell River on northern Vancouver Island, managed by the City of Campbell River. The reserve protects a creek corridor within an urban setting, offering a natural respite along what is otherwise a mid-sized coastal city. Touring cyclists riding the Vancouver Island route through Campbell River may find it a useful green-space stop, though specific trail and facility details were not available from the website.
